# Copilot Instructions

This is **reactionchain**, a UI application built using the **iris-ui** shared component library.

## Project Overview
- A UI application that consumes components and utilities from the iris-ui library.
- UI elements should be sourced from iris-ui where possible rather than building custom components from scratch.

## Guidelines
- Prefer using iris-ui components over writing custom UI components.
- If a needed component does not exist in iris-ui, consider whether it belongs in iris-ui as a shared component first.
